signIn.title: Staff console
signIn.lead: Sign in with your LevApp Google account.

error.NOT_STAFF_DOMAIN: Only @levapp.app accounts can sign in. Use the company account.
error.NO_ADMIN_ROLE: Your account has no console access. Ask the owner for a role.
error.GOOGLE_TOKEN_INVALID: Google did not validate the sign-in. Try again.

notConfigured.title: Sign-in not configured
notConfigured.body: This environment has no Google OAuth client yet. ADMIN_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID is empty in the server environment; the console opens as soon as the value exists.

home.empty: Operations (approvals, users, clubs, engine health) arrive in the next parts.

roles.title: Console access
roles.lead: Who can sign in, and as what. Only the owner changes this.

error.LAST_OWNER: There must always be an owner.
error.ADMIN_ROLE_TOO_LOW: Only the owner can do this.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.lead: Who changed what, before and after, and when. It cannot be edited or deleted.
